```{=html}
<div class="screen-only">
  <b>WS-16-seam-placement-canvas</b> &middot; review copy &middot; declared format <b>A1 landscape</b> &middot;
  2 sheet(s). Sheet 1 is the wall canvas; sheet 2 is the register that travels with it.
  Each white page below is one physical sheet at true size.
  Anything spilling past a page edge onto this grey background is a layout defect.
</div>

<!-- ============================ SHEET 1 ============================== -->
<div class="sheet">
  <div class="ws-head">
    <div>
      <h1>Draw the Seam: Deterministic / Probabilistic Canvas</h1>
      <p class="ws-sub">A marked-up architecture canvas with the seam explicitly drawn, plus a red-circle list of every consequential effect currently sitting on the wrong side.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-16-seam-placement-canvas</b><br>
      Pack D - Architecture and ownership<br>
      fill order <b>3</b> &middot; type <b>canvas</b><br>
      audience <b>architect</b>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="ws-source">
    Source: <b>The Deterministic/Probabilistic Boundary</b>, <i>Two Computers, One Program</i> &middot;
    <code>handbook/ch16-deterministic-probabilistic-boundary.qmd</code> L18-41 &middot;
    <a href="https://danielmeppiel.github.io/agentic-sdlc-handbook/handbook/ch16-deterministic-probabilistic-boundary.html#sec-seam-two-computers">#sec-seam-two-computers</a>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-instruction">
    Sketch your intended agentic system on this canvas. Write each box on a sticky and place it on the deterministic side or the probabilistic side of the heavy line &mdash; never on the line itself. Then draw and label each arrow that crosses the line in each direction: what goes in (prompts, tool schemas, grounded file contents) and what comes out (proposals, never direct writes). Anything consequential left on the probabilistic side gets a red dot: a design defect to be redrawn. Record every box and arrow on sheet 2.
  </div>

  <div class="ws-block" style="flex:1 1 auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0">
    <h2>Canvas <span class="ws-block-note">one system per canvas &middot; stickies for boxes &middot; red dots for defects</span></h2>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:4mm;flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0">
      <div style="flex:0 0 17%;font-size:7.4pt">
        <h2 style="font-size:9pt;margin:0 0 1.5mm">Block C &mdash; the two-computers legend <span class="ws-block-note">printed, read-only</span></h2>
        <table class="ws"><colgroup><col style="width:20%"><col style="width:40%"><col style="width:40%"></colgroup><thead><tr><th>17 Legend row</th><th>18 Deterministic cell</th><th>19 Probabilistic cell</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td class="prior"><b>What it does</b><span class="prior-src">ch16 L28-35</span></td><td class="prior">File I/O, tool calls, schema validation, test execution, lockfile resolution, allowlist enforcement, audit emission<span class="prior-src">ch16 L30-35</span></td><td class="prior">Reads code, drafts prose, proposes diffs, summarizes intent, picks among options, generates plans<span class="prior-src">ch16 L30-35</span></td></tr><tr><td class="prior"><b>Failure mode</b><span class="prior-src">ch16 L28-35</span></td><td class="prior">Crash, exception, validation error — loud and traceable<span class="prior-src">ch16 L30-35</span></td><td class="prior">Confident plausible wrong — silent and unfalsifiable from inside the model<span class="prior-src">ch16 L30-35</span></td></tr><tr><td class="prior"><b>What you trust</b><span class="prior-src">ch16 L28-35</span></td><td class="prior">The exact output, byte for byte<span class="prior-src">ch16 L30-35</span></td><td class="prior">A distribution of outputs, conditioned on a prompt<span class="prior-src">ch16 L30-35</span></td></tr><tr><td class="prior"><b>What it costs</b><span class="prior-src">ch16 L28-35</span></td><td class="prior">Engineering hours per gate<span class="prior-src">ch16 L30-35</span></td><td class="prior">Tokens per call, plus the cost of every failure that crosses the seam unverified<span class="prior-src">ch16 L30-35</span></td></tr><tr><td class="prior"><b>What crosses → into it</b><span class="prior-src">ch16 L28-35</span></td><td class="prior">Structured prompts, declared tool schemas, file contents grounded by <code>compile</code>-time loaders<span class="prior-src">ch16 L30-35</span></td><td class="prior">Proposed actions (text), proposed writes (text), structured tool-call requests<span class="prior-src">ch16 L30-35</span></td></tr><tr><td class="prior"><b>What crosses ← out of it</b><span class="prior-src">ch16 L28-35</span></td><td class="prior">Parsed outputs validated against schema, writes filtered through an allowlist, flagged escalations to humans<span class="prior-src">ch16 L30-35</span></td><td class="prior">Nothing direct: every probabilistic output passes through deterministic validation before it has consequences<span class="prior-src">ch16 L30-35</span></td></tr></tbody></table>
      </div>
      <div class="canvas" style="position:relative">
        <div class="canvas__half">
          <h3>The deterministic computer &mdash; what you can audit</h3>
          <div class="zone"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="canvas__seam"><span class="seam-label">the seam</span></div>
        <div class="canvas__half">
          <h3>The probabilistic computer &mdash; what you cannot</h3>
          <div class="zone"></div>
        </div>
        <div style="position:absolute;left:12%;right:12%;top:30%;z-index:2">
          <div class="channel"><span class="arrow">&rarr;</span><span><b>what crosses into the probabilistic side</b></span></div>
        </div>
        <div style="position:absolute;left:12%;right:12%;top:62%;z-index:2">
          <div class="channel"><span class="arrow">&larr;</span><span><b>what crosses out of it</b> &mdash; <i>"Nothing direct: every probabilistic output passes through deterministic validation before it has consequences."</i> <span class="prior-src" style="display:inline">ch16 L35</span></span></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p style="font-size:8pt;margin:1.5mm 0 0"><span class="redcircle"></span> &nbsp;<span class="defect-note">Red dot</span>
      &mdash; a consequential effect sitting on the probabilistic side. A design defect to be redrawn, not a note.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-foot-quote">
    "The probabilistic side is allowed to <i>propose</i> anything; it is allowed to <i>do</i> nothing." (ch16 L37)
  </div>

  <div class="ws-foot">
    <div>WS-16-seam-placement-canvas &middot; The Agentic SDLC Handbook worksheet kit &middot; sheet 1 of 2</div>
    <div>Filled by <span style="display:inline-block;width:40mm;border-bottom:.25mm solid #93a0ad"></span>
      &nbsp; Date <span style="display:inline-block;width:24mm;border-bottom:.25mm solid #93a0ad"></span></div>
  </div>
</div>
```
